decisions: Logic connectives banned in a frame include 'so', 'because', 'since', 'if', 'only', 'unless', 'while', 'when'; 'and', 'but', 'then' are allowed. The C5 starter lists 'so, because, but' as plain joining words: the gate refuses 'so' and 'because' (a causal word between two desk clauses claims a link nobody checked). Flagged for the coordinator: the starter's joining words and the gate's floor disagree on those two.
Units in a frame: unit words and case-sensitive unit symbols (V, mA, ms, W ...) are refused; a capital 'A' alone is not (it is also the article).
The fact sheet's verdict slot is ANSWER = 'Yes', 'No', 'I cannot tell' or 'I cannot tell yet'; the heading is math_answers.HEADINGS of the sheet's state.
A changed source (freshness REVIEW_REQUIRED) makes the sheet 'cannot tell yet' and keeps the earlier answer only as 'on the sources as they were, ...'.

'A missing tolerance' is a caveat slot (TOLERANCE) from the settle stage's break_even: the first input in receipt order with no tolerance, its break-even rounded down ('up to' when the end is closed, 'under' when open).

Rounding places come from the desk's own numbers for that quantity (12 V, 11.75 V -> 2 places; 340 mA -> 0), at least 3 and at most 6 figures; this gives the design's 11.76 V and 326 mA from one rule.
A frame may hold no quotation mark (quoted words are exempt from mind_words' banned scan, so quotes could smuggle words) and no letter outside plain Latin (homoglyphs).

The WORDS check is called with goals=None (its holds/over word test would misread a cannot-tell sentence that names a failing corner); the heading check is the gate's own (ANSWER first, its state = the heading).
Her sentence budget: her character's per register, but never below what her own plain frame for the sheet needs (the period sheet needs 4 sentences, formal allows 4).
